verdict.rationale: Slack documents generic 'export workspace data' tools and an import/export guide, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of configurable retention policies or legal-hold features for eDiscovery. Community evidence (slack-comm-8) notes that even export access is gated behind Slack's approval for 'legal or compliance requirements,' and other community comments (slack-comm-4, slack-comm-6) describe message history as difficult to preserve without a paid plan, adding real friction to compliance workflows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of retention-policy configuration, legal-hold workflow, audit trail for holds, and independent confirmation of eDiscovery export completeness.
